text:
incident-bot: PAGING: Control plane elevated error rate (5xx/timeouts) across auth, org-lookup, and config fanout. Pager: @alex (oncall). Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/ops/alerts/17945

alex: taking this. I see gateway 502/504 spike, auth upstream 502s, org-lookup timeouts spiking. Starting triage.

alex: Quick numbers: overall control-plane 5xx ~12% (5m window), /v1/token 5xx ~14%, auth p95 latency 6s (norm 1.9s), org-lookup 90th ~7s. Correlates with config-service fanout errors.

maria: any recent deploys? logs show repeated `fanout` calls to billing-config with `context.deadline_exceeded`.

alex: no gitlab deploy in last 30m. config-service CPU and GC look high in metrics.

sandeep: scaling config-service now and will bump org-lookup client timeout to reduce cascading.

lina: recommend short-circuiting org-lookup via KV cache (5m TTL) while we stabilize. Maria, can you flip a runtime flag?

maria: I can. Preparing runtime flag: `REDWOOD_ORGLOOKUP_CACHE=true`. Applying to control-plane prod now.

maria: applied flag at 1794500120

alex: confirmed gateway traces show far fewer org-lookup calls after 1794500125. 5xx dropping from 12% -> 6% within 2m.

sandeep: scaling config-service +3 replicas at 1794500185.

ops-bot: action: scale initiated for service=config-service, target_replicas=6, started_at=1794500190

alex: auth 502s still present for a subset of tenants. Hypothesis: auth token-exchange hitting DB timeouts; pinging auth team.

raj: looking into auth. DB CPU high; seeing large slow queries from a background billing job coincident with error spike. Killing heavy job now.

raj: killed billing job at 1794500250. Watching auth error tail.

alex: auth 5xx tail dropping now. Control plane 5xx at ~1.8% at 1794500305.

incident-bot: Update: mitigations applied — orglookup cache enabled, config-service scaled, blocking billing job killed. Please confirm if pager should be cleared.

alex: Confirming stabilizing. I'll continue monitoring. Impact summary for ops/CS: degraded control-plane for ~18m, peak ~12% 5xx, token exchange failures surfaced to some customers. Not rolling back any customer config now; mitigation sufficient. Notifying CS.

lina: creating follow-ups: RCA for billing job causing DB pressure + config fanout hotspots. Add circuit-breaker and better backoff on config fanout.

maria: follow-up actions: 1) add circuit-breaker on config fanout, 2) increase org-lookup client timeout/backoff, 3) run slow-query analysis on auth DB, 4) add deploy safety check for billing jobs.

alex: I'll hand off to next oncall (sandeep) in ~15m. sandeep, can you monitor for regressions and update this channel if anything pops?

sandeep: taking over monitoring. Will watch metrics and traces for 1h. Thanks team :thumbsup:

maria: marking incident as mitigated; leaving open for RCA and postmortem.

alex: closing pager and moving to post-incident tasks. Great job everyone.

incident-bot: Pager cleared by alex at 1794500460
